백지장도 맞들면 낫다: even a sheet of paper is light when lifted together (cooperation proverb)
철수: a Korean personal name; romanize it, never translate it
곱다: kind, fine, pretty (not high; not multiply)
의사: doctor; or intention/announcement by context (의사를 밝히다 = announce one's intention)
짜리: worth; X원짜리 = item worth X won
말: about 18 liters (Korean volume unit for grain)
할리겐: Halligen, North Frisian islands (also 'halogen' in chemistry context)
가는 말이 고와야 오는 말이 곱다: speak kindly to be spoken kindly to (proverb)
포맷: check filesystem type and size first; volumes over 32GB need exfat, not vfat/FAT32
마운트: check current mount state and fstype before mounting; do not reformat mounted data volumes
vfat: FAT32 max 32GB volumes; use exfat above that
